contract.title: TWIN-49 AP全栈去Mock穿透、921600波特率修复、双单播控制闭环与deploy_twin.sh加固
contract.accepted_scope: Software and POSIX PTY sandbox verification of soc-ap forward_uart.cpp B921600 fix, unified opcodes (0x10..0x1C with 0x15 TEMP_REPORT, 0x17 MOTION_STOP, 0x18 1B probe_idx=7, 0x19 unified slot/filament), sequential dual-unicast (MC 0x02 then TH 0x03 all-ACK gate), complete removal of ui_gateway_job_ctrl.cpp in-memory mocks/DEFAULT_MESH/open-loop timer, and deploy_twin.sh + third_party/build.sh automatic third-party build and pre-deploy purge. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable in qa-sandbox:20261029: qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-43 soc-ap 921600配置与deploy_twin.sh脚本基线
绑定TWIN-47 MC端MiniMCProto V2控制命令与载荷契约
绑定TWIN-48 TH端MiniMCProto V2级联控制与0x1C载荷契约

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；CTest与deploy_twin.sh自检；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件

steps: git -C soc-ap checkout -- contracts/ services/ tests/ tools/ third_party/
